summary:
Self-criticism and self-compassion are often treated as one dial: turn kindness up and the critic turns down. Research suggests they work more like two separate dials, and the harsh side is more closely linked with distress. For many people, being less harsh is a more reachable first step than being kinder.

Our new blog by psychologist Matthew Hallam explains what the research shows and offers practical ways to notice the inner critic.

Equal Psychology offers psychology for adults and older adults in Kew, Croydon, and online across Melbourne.

Medicare rebates available with a GP referral.

Read the blog: https://www.equalpsychology.com.au/post/being-less-harsh-may-matter-more-than-being-kinder
